sources.title: all-mpnet-base-v2: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview all-mpnet-base-v2 is a sentence embedding model developed by sentence-transformers that maps sentences and paragraphs to a 768-dimensional dense vector space. The model is built on the pretrained microsoft/mpnet-base backbone and fine-tuned using contrastive learning on over 1 billion sentence pairs across diverse datasets including Reddit comments, scientific papers, Stack Exchange ...

sources.title: All-mpnet-base-v2: Specs, Hardware & Live AI Battle | ModelVault
sources.snippet: All-mpnet-base-v2 is a versatile open-weight language model developed by Hugging Face. Built on modern Transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), All-mpnet-base-v2 delivers strong performance in instruction following, multi-turn dialogue, creative synthesis, and structured JSON output generation.
